items.prompt: One single standalone character reference image, cinematic stylized 3D animation, Edwardian 1910. The supplied input is the identity and costume source: keep EXACTLY the same fictional person, age, build, face proportions, hairstyle, facial hair or clean-shaven state, spectacles or absence, hat, fabric colours, garment cut, buttons, shoes and accessories. Head, torso, knees and both shoes all point LEFT. NOT frontal, NOT three-quarter. This is a technical character turnaround side elevation. Entire body with shoes and hair/required headwear inside frame. 【C01锚点】瘦小中年男子,圆框金边眼镜,浓密八字胡,深灰三件套西装,神情温顺. BARE HEAD: absolutely NO HAT, NO CAP, NO BOWLER, NO added headwear. Hair must remain exposed exactly as source. Neutral light grey seamless studio background, soft neutral studio light, detailed wool, skin and hair. Natural anatomy and hands. Only change camera angle/framing, not character design. No extra people, no duplicated figures, no labels or writing, no text, no watermark, no panels, no contact sheet, no collage. Not a real person portrait. IMAGE 1 is the PRIMARY STRUCTURAL COMPOSITION: preserve its EXACT camera angle and full-body pose. IMAGE 2 supplies ONLY this character face/head identity. IMAGE 3 supplies ONLY this character clothing, gender, build, accessories and materials. Dress and identify the image 1 figure using images 2 and 3. The pose from IMAGE 1 is mandatory; never copy the three-quarter angle from image 3. Do not copy generic grey clothes, face or male shape from image 1; keep image 3 gender and build.
